ready_documents.title: Refund completion and settlement
ready_documents.markdown: A refund is complete only after Finance records a refund reference and completion date. Support may state the recorded status, but must not promise a bank settlement date.

ready_documents.title: Returns policy — version 2026-08-15
ready_documents.markdown: Current policy: eligible physical goods may be returned within 30 days of delivery. A damaged-goods report needs an order number and a photo review before a replacement or refund is approved.

ready_documents.title: Returns policy — superseded 2025-11-01
ready_documents.markdown: SUPERSEDED: the former return period was 14 days. This page is retained for historical reference and must not be quoted as current policy.

ready_documents.title: Spanish support style
ready_documents.markdown: When a customer writes in Spanish, answer in clear Spanish. Ask for missing order or account details before asserting an account-specific status.

ready_documents.title: Subscription pause and address changes
ready_documents.markdown: A customer can choose a one-cycle pause or update an upcoming shipment address before its cutoff. Present choices without claiming either change has already been made.

ready_documents.title: Enterprise cancellation exception — current
ready_documents.markdown: For the Enterprise Annual plan, the current cancellation exception is: requests received before the renewal invoice is issued can be cancelled at the end of the current term. Do not state that a cancellation is complete unless an observed cancellation event exists.

draft_documents.title: DRAFT — proposed 90 day returns policy
draft_documents.markdown: DRAFT ONLY. A proposed 90 day return period has not been approved or published.
